notes: Search 7 was the cap; nhs.uk chickenpox/measles pages were not returned directly, so attributions rest on NHS inform, NHS trust/ICB pages and GOV.UK summaries that blended pages. MMRV claim reworded to 'added to routine schedule from January 2026' (UKHSA/GOV.UK); schedule replacement and free MMR catch-up claims dropped. Infectious period for chickenpox kept to '1 to 2 days before rash' plus GOV.UK 5-day exclusion; conflicting 5/7-day wordings dropped. Pregnancy/immune route kept only as 'contact GP for advice' (NHS page advises urgent help); receptionist/blood-test claims dropped. nhs.uk/conditions/meningitis/ used in place of the symptoms sub-page (not returned). Chickenpox 999 list rests on an NHS ICB parent page. Search noted NHS inform says new spots can appear 3-5 days vs 7-day ICB wording; the post cites the 7-day item as a reason for urgent help only. Lead author removed the "new spots after seven days" sentence because NHS inform gives a different window (3 to 5 days) and the sources conflict.
